#!/bin/bash
#FLUX -N 2
#FLUX -n 2
#FLUX --gpus-per-task=4
#FLUX -q regular
#FLUX -t 01:00:00
# The Slurm directive '-A m4138' (account) has been omitted. In Flux,
# this is typically specified at submission time, e.g., 'flux submit --account=m4138'.
# The Slurm directive '-C gpu' (constraint) is implicitly handled by the
# resource request for GPUs (--gpus-per-task).

cd /pscratch/sd/z/zjia//nccl-tests
module load cray-mpich/8.1.25
# nccl/2.15.5-ofi
module load nccl
# cudatoolkit/11.7
module load cudatoolkit
conda activate qs

export MPICH_GPU_SUPPORT_ENABLED=1
# make MPI=1 MPI_HOME=$CRAY_MPICH_DIR CUDA_HOME=/opt/nvidia/hpc_sdk/Linux_x86_64/22.7/cuda/11.7 NCCL_HOME=/global/common/software/nersc/pm-2022q4/sw/nccl-2.15.5-ofi-r4
GPUSPERNODE=4
# The Slurm srun command is replaced by flux run.
# The Slurm variable SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES is replaced by the Flux equivalent FLUX_JOB_NNODES.
flux run \
     --ntasks="$(( FLUX_JOB_NNODES ))" \
     --tasks-per-node=1\
     ./build/alltoall_perf -b 4G -e 4G -f 2 -d double -g ${GPUSPERNODE} -w 0 -n 10 > nccl-2nodes.log

issues: The `flux run` command uses `--ntasks` and `--tasks-per-node` which redundantly specify the resource layout already defined by the global `#FLUX -N 2` and `#FLUX -n 2` directives. While not an error, these flags could be omitted for simplicity as `flux run` would inherit the layout from the allocation.

The variable `GPUSPERNODE` is hardcoded to 4. This correctly matches the requested resources in this script (`--gpus-per-task=4` with one task per node), but it would be more robust to derive this value from a Flux environment variable to make the script more adaptable to changes in the resource request.
The path in the `cd` command `/pscratch/sd/z/zjia//nccl-tests` contains a double slash `//`. While this is typically resolved correctly by the shell, it is stylistically unconventional.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH -A m4138
#SBATCH -C gpu
#SBATCH -q regular
#SBATCH -t 01:00:00
#SBATCH -N 2
#SBATCH --gpus-per-node=4

cd /pscratch/sd/z/zjia//nccl-tests
module load cray-mpich/8.1.25
# nccl/2.15.5-ofi
module load nccl
# cudatoolkit/11.7
module load cudatoolkit
conda activate qs

export MPICH_GPU_SUPPORT_ENABLED=1
# make MPI=1 MPI_HOME=$CRAY_MPICH_DIR CUDA_HOME=/opt/nvidia/hpc_sdk/Linux_x86_64/22.7/cuda/11.7 NCCL_HOME=/global/common/software/nersc/pm-2022q4/sw/nccl-2.15.5-ofi-r4
GPUSPERNODE=4
srun -u \
     --ntasks="$(( SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES ))" \
     --ntasks-per-node=1\
     ./build/alltoall_perf -b 4G -e 4G -f 2 -d double -g ${GPUSPERNODE} -w 0 -n 10 > nccl-2nodes.log
